exact_identity.statement: Absolute owner-labelled ROLE_CAPPAR+ZOE and mover/opponent-labelled ROLE_CAPPAR+ZOE induce identical partitions on every tested hard carrier.
exact_identity.reason: Side-to-move parity is reconstructible from the repaired signature and role-capacity bits are unchanged by owner-channel swap, so the normalization is reversible.

findings.statement: Mover-relative owner normalization is an exact reversible representation gauge for the repaired scalar signature on the tested carriers.

Mover-relative normalization does not reduce decoder degree or structural rank consistently; complete degree two becomes less effective on all three hard carriers even though affine contradictions fall slightly on two.
The absolute-owner ROLE_CAPPAR gauge remains the preferred current decoder realization because it has smaller degree-2 contradiction counts and smaller OOO cubic rank gains on every hard carrier.

nonclaims: The mover-relative gauge is not semantically inferior; it is partition-equivalent.
No claim is made that absolute-owner labels are intrinsically fundamental.
No Q-A/Q-F or standard-7x6 claim follows.
next_question: Can exact relative-depth magnitude be reduced while keeping the preferred absolute-owner ROLE_CAPPAR+ZOE coordinate scalar-exact?
